theorems.name: Submission.lpf_wtc_tangent_transfer
theorems.statement: ∀ (Q n : ℕ) (C N : Set (Eucl Q)) (y : Eucl Q) (T : Submodule ℝ (Eucl Q)), NullMeasurableSet C (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) → NullMeasurableSet N (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) → Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N y T → (∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) (N ∩ closedBall y r) < ∞) → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) ((C \ N) ∩ closedBall y ρ) / ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) ((N \ C) ∩ closedBall y ρ) / ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n C y T
